verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer in-product AI insights or suggestions on a filer's data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the front door and the ORION portal blocked by bot walls. None of it describes any AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the verdict is none.
